codeReview.summary: Clean module split of launa-esp-ota/src/lib.rs (1745 lines) into 3 focused modules: crypto.rs (315 lines - SHA-256, HMAC-SHA256, CRC-32/MPEG-2), flash.rs (218 lines - partition operations, otadata read-modify-write), ota.rs (1240 lines - EspOtaFlash state machine, OtaUpdate impl, all 46 tests). lib.rs reduced to 40 lines with module declarations and re-exports. All 46 tests preserved with identical names. Public API is identical: EspOtaFlash, Partition, SigningKey, crc32, crc32_update all accessible from crate root.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The architecture.md documents launa-esp-ota but should be updated to reflect the new module structure (crypto, flash, ota modules) for future workers who need to navigate the crate.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: architecture.md describes launa-esp-ota as a single block without mentioning the module split. After this commit, the crate has 3 internal modules + lib.rs re-exports.
